provenance_policy: Strict provenance enforcement (REAL, PUBLIC_EXTERNAL, SIMULATED, ASSUMED)
field_disclaimer: Demonstration/simulated data. Deployment requires calibration on validated Baghewala field data.

datasets.name: Baghewala 10-Well Integrated Digital Twin Simulation
datasets.source: Petro-Twin Physics Core (Marx-Langenheim + Gibbs Wave SRP)
datasets.purpose: Digital twin forward simulation, UI dashboards, and optimizer benchmarking
datasets.preprocessing_steps: Added 2% Gaussian noise, 1.5% simulated sensor dropouts (NaNs), and 1% outlier spikes
datasets.known_limitations: Simulated reservoir response; requires field recalibration prior to operational actuation

datasets.name: Baghewala Well Static Specifications
datasets.source: Petrotech & SPE literature on Bikaner-Nagaur Basin Jodhpur sandstone
datasets.purpose: Static wellbore and reservoir geometry initialization
datasets.preprocessing_steps: Literature parameter extraction and unit conversion to metric standards

datasets.name: Rajasthan Extra-Heavy Crude Viscosity-Temperature Model
datasets.source: Published Andrade constants for Rajasthan extra-heavy oil
datasets.purpose: Calibrating Andrade A and B parameters for thermal viscosity swing
datasets.known_limitations: Does not account for non-Newtonian shear-thinning at ultra-high shear rates without ML residual correction
